readmeExcerpt: # Sonarr Sonarr is a PVR for Usenet and BitTorrent users. It can monitor multiple RSS feeds for new episodes of your favorite shows and will grab, sort and rename them. It can also be configured to automatically upgrade the quality of files already downloaded when a better quality format becomes available. ## Getting Started - [Download/Installation](https://sonarr.tv/#downloads-v3) - [FAQ](https://wiki.servarr.com/sonarr/faq) - [Wiki](https://wiki.servarr.com/Sonarr) - [API Documentation](https://sonarr.tv/docs/api) - [Donate](https://sonarr.tv/donate) ## Support Note: GitHub Issues are for Bugs and Feature Requests Only - [Forums](https://forums.sonarr.tv/) - [Discord](https://discord.gg/M6BvZn5) - [GitHub - Bugs and Feature Requests Only](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/issues) - [IRC](https://web.libera.chat/?channels=#sonarr) - [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/sonarr) - [Wiki](https://wiki.servarr.com/sonarr) ## Features ### Current Features - Support for major platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS, Raspberry Pi, etc. - Automatically detects new episodes - Can scan your existing library and download any missing episodes - Can watch for better quality of the episodes you already have and do an automatic upgrade. _eg. from DVD to Blu-Ray_ - Automatic failed download handling will try another release if one fails - Manual search so you can pick any release or to see why a release was not downloaded automatically - Fully configurable episode renaming - Full integration with SABnzbd and NZBGet - Full integration with Kodi, Plex (notification, library update, metadata) - Full support for specials and multi-episode releases - And a beautiful UI ## Contributing ### Development This project exists thanks to all the people who contribute. [Contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md). ### Supporters This project would not be possible without the support of our users and software providers. readmeHtml:
Sonarr

Sonarr is a PVR for Usenet and BitTorrent users. It can monitor multiple RSS feeds for new episodes of your favorite shows and will grab, sort and rename them. It can also be configured to automatically upgrade the quality of files already downloaded when a better quality format becomes available.

Getting Started

  • Download/Installation
  • FAQ
  • Wiki
  • API Documentation
  • Donate

Support

Note: GitHub Issues are for Bugs and Feature Requests Only

  • Forums
  • Discord
  • GitHub - Bugs and Feature Requests Only
  • IRC
  • Reddit
  • Wiki

Features

Current Features

  • Support for major platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS, Raspberry Pi, etc.
  • Automatically detects new episodes
  • Can scan your existing library and download any missing episodes
  • Can watch for better quality of the episodes you already have and do an automatic upgrade. eg. from DVD to Blu-Ray
  • Automatic failed download handling will try another release if one fails
  • Manual search so you can pick any release or to see why a release was not downloaded automatically
  • Fully configurable episode renaming
  • Full integration with SABnzbd and NZBGet
  • Full integration with Kodi, Plex (notification, library update, metadata)
  • Full support for specials and multi-episode releases
  • And a beautiful UI

Contributing

Development

This project exists thanks to all the people who contribute. Contribute.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A smart PVR for Usenet and BitTorrent that automates downloading, sorting, and upgrading TV shows.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Sonarr is a personal video recorder (PVR) designed specifically for television shows, catering to both Usenet and BitTorrent users. It operates by continuously monitoring multiple RSS feeds to detect when new episodes of specified shows become available. Once detected, it automatically grabs the files, sorts them into appropriate folders, and renames them according to user preferences. A standout feature is its ability to automatically upgrade the quality of existing downloaded files if a better format is later released. It provides a comprehensive interface for managing vast television libraries efficiently.
keyFeatures: RSS monitoring: Scans multiple configured RSS feeds continuously to detect new episode releases.
Automated downloading: Grabs detected files automatically via connected Usenet or BitTorrent clients.
Quality upgrading: Replaces existing downloaded files automatically when higher quality versions become available.
Library organization: Sorts and renames downloaded files according to customizable naming conventions.
Comprehensive API: Offers a fully featured API to allow integration with external tools and dashboards.

useCases.title: Automated media downloading
useCases.description: Configure the system once to automatically download new episodes of favorite shows as they air.

useCases.title: Library organization
useCases.description: Rename and structure messy download folders into a clean, uniform media library.

useCases.title: Quality management
useCases.description: Upgrade standard definition episodes to high definition automatically when releases are found.

useCases.title: Dashboard integration
useCases.description: Connect the application's API to media center dashboards like Plex or Jellyfin for seamless syncing.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Home server administrators and media enthusiasts who want to automate their television show downloading and organization. Users should be familiar with configuring Usenet or BitTorrent clients.
